notes: Random records A and B (sides often 0/1/2 and sometimes equal, B kind 0/3/7/12 or random, sound byte, task word 0xff or not, positions within +-200000), eight table rows with random task words, active unit 0xff or a row, player word equal or not, reply odds byte nonzero, sound-enable double zero, negative zero, denormal or nonzero.
